cards.example: I always procrastinate when I have a big project due.
cards.exampleZh: 每次有大專案要交,我總是拖延。

cards.example: She managed to accomplish all her goals this year.
cards.exampleZh: 她今年設法達成了所有目標。

cards.example: It's more convenient to pay by card.
cards.exampleZh: 用卡付款比較方便。

cards.example: I was exhausted after the long meeting.
cards.exampleZh: 開完那場冗長會議後我筋疲力盡。

cards.example: He's a reliable friend who always keeps his promises.
cards.exampleZh: 他是個可靠的朋友,總是信守承諾。

cards.example: I really appreciate your help with this.
cards.exampleZh: 我真的很感激你在這件事上的幫忙。

cards.example: She felt embarrassed after forgetting his name.
cards.exampleZh: 忘記他的名字後她覺得很尷尬。

cards.example: We need to negotiate a better price.
cards.exampleZh: 我們需要談判出更好的價格。

cards.meaning: 延後(把預定時間往後挪)
cards.example: The meeting was postponed until next week.
cards.exampleZh: 會議被延到下週。

cards.example: The kids were curious about the new machine.
cards.exampleZh: 孩子們對這台新機器感到好奇。

cards.example: Don't exaggerate the problem, it's not that bad.
cards.exampleZh: 別誇大問題,沒那麼糟。

cards.example: He felt frustrated when the printer kept jamming.
cards.exampleZh: 印表機一直卡紙讓他感到很挫折。

cards.example: Water is essential for survival.
cards.exampleZh: 水對生存是必要的。

cards.example: She made a tremendous effort to finish on time.
cards.exampleZh: 她付出極大的努力才準時完成。

cards.example: We anticipate strong sales this quarter.
cards.exampleZh: 我們預期這一季的銷售會很好。

cards.example: He was reluctant to admit his mistake.
cards.exampleZh: 他不情願承認自己的錯誤。

cards.example: We don't have sufficient time to finish this today.
cards.exampleZh: 我們沒有足夠時間今天完成這件事。

cards.example: She's an ambitious young manager.
cards.exampleZh: 她是個有抱負的年輕經理。

cards.example: Some delays are simply inevitable.
cards.exampleZh: 有些延誤根本無可避免。

cards.example: Don't hesitate to ask if you have questions.
cards.exampleZh: 有問題別猶豫,儘管問。

cards.example: It took a while to persuade him to join us.
cards.exampleZh: 花了一段時間才說服他加入我們。

cards.example: She felt overwhelmed by all the emails.
cards.exampleZh: 大量的郵件讓她感到不知所措。

cards.example: His apology sounded genuine.
cards.exampleZh: 他的道歉聽起來很真誠。

cards.example: My work schedule is pretty flexible.
cards.exampleZh: 我的工作時間表相當有彈性。

cards.example: They reached a compromise after a long discussion.
cards.exampleZh: 經過長時間討論後他們達成了妥協。

cards.example: He dedicated years to this research.
cards.exampleZh: 他為這項研究奉獻了好幾年。

cards.example: I'm a bit skeptical about that claim.
cards.exampleZh: 我對那個說法有點懷疑。

cards.example: It's inconvenient to travel during rush hour.
cards.exampleZh: 尖峰時間出門很不方便。

cards.example: She did a thorough review of the report.
cards.exampleZh: 她對報告做了徹底的檢查。

cards.example: He reassured her that everything would be fine.
cards.exampleZh: 他向她保證一切都會沒事。
